283536033.description:
Natural Purple Amethyst Cluster
Mineral Geode Specimen with Cut Flat Base
Natural Amethyst Quartz, 5 Inches Tall, 1.6 lbs
This natural purple amethyst crystal geode cluster specimen features a dense formation of sparkling crystalline quartz points lining an interior cavity. Characterized by rich violet tones, the formation exhibits concentric agate and quartz matrix banding along its natural rock rind. Cut with a level base, it stands freely for upright presentation as an earth science specimen, altar stone, or display accent.
Naturally formed amethyst quartz crystal points in rich violet hues
Natural outer rock matrix rind showcasing surrounding agate banding
Cut flat base allows for stable, upright tabletop or shelf display
Measures approximately 5 inches tall, 4 inches long, 3 inches wide; weighs 1.6 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimen with inherent crystal matrix variations, natural terminations, and rough rock textures. No artificial repairs or synthetic coatings observed. Cut base is stable and sits flat for upright display.
